from manim import *

class StoryboardScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # Frame 1: The problem: searching in a sorted list
        title = Text("The problem: searching in a sorted list")
        boxes = VGroup(*[Text(str(n)).scale(0.7) for n in [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.6)
        group = VGroup(title, boxes).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.8)
        self.add(group)
        self.wait(8)
        self.clear()
        # Frame 2: Check the middle, then discard half
        title = Text("Check the middle, then discard half")
        self.add(title)
        self.wait(10)
changeLog: Frame 1: Added a simple row of labeled items to visually represent a sorted list while keeping the original frame timing and mapping comment unchanged.
